messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: A note of thanks...
parts:
Since today is American Thanksgiving (and by some odd coincidence, I'm American...),
I wanted to thank all of you for teaching me so much about how to use ggplot2 over the
last year. In particular, I want to thank Hadley for creating this beautiful graphics system
and for the various other packages he's (co-)authored for R, as well as opening my mind
to new ways of thinking about data and data analysis.

With warm appreciation,
Dennis

Warmest wishes to one and all!
